global: This tonkotsu ramen boasts a rich, golden broth, topped with chashu pork, menma, and a delicate naruto fish cake. The bowl, with red-trimmed patterns, holds the ingredients artfully arranged, set against a softly blurred background under warm, inviting light.

regions.background: Dark, smooth wooden table surface with subtle grain patterns and soft, warm lighting reflections.
regions.bowl: The ceramic bowl has a glossy red exterior with gold dragon patterns and a white interior rim.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu (pork bone) broth is golden-yellow, glossy, and viscous, swirling around noodles in a curved, incomplete ring.
regions.spoon: A white ceramic spoon with smooth, slightly curved surface and rounded tip, partially submerged in broth.
regions.seaweed: Dark, glossy nori seaweed sheet, triangular, with visible texture and slight curl at edges.
regions.meat: The chashu pork slice is round, pale pink with a golden-brown seared edge, showing tender, slightly marbled texture.
regions.menma: Menma bamboo shoots appear pale yellow, glossy, and sliced into irregular, slightly curved, translucent strips.
regions.naruto: Naruto fish cake: pale pink swirls on white, scalloped edges, soft texture, delicate surface details.
